ubindok.hostManaged_zero: clear managed state and permit fallback reporting; do not send proactive requests

Utm.msgId: current shared uint32 counter; normalize to zero before send only when above 65535

getLoginInfo.msgId: preincrement shared uint32 counter with no local uint16 wrap before send

ubindok.callback_timer_units: seconds; 100-ms countdown source resolves this as 60 seconds

udp_worker.getLoginInfo_gate: state byte +7 high bit; send once then write 0x4f
udp_worker.getLoginInfo_gate_state_pointer_base: 0x10016db6; both worker state pointers resolve to this base
udp_worker.source_timer_initializer: 0x9b0333d4 creates an autoreload 100-ms timer with callback 0x9b033314
udp_worker.byte_timer_countdown_abi: On each 100-ms callback, subtract one from active byte values; when subtraction reaches exact active marker 0x40 from 0x41, replace it with expired high-bit 0x80. An initial 0x40 subtracts to 0x3f
udp_worker.halfword_countdown_abi: On each one-second table update, subtract one from active halfword values; when subtraction reaches exact active marker 0x4000 from 0x4001, replace it with expired high-bit 0x8000. An initial 0x4000 subtracts to 0x3fff
udp_worker.halfword_expiry_phase: 30 one-second table updates; the first update is on the shared 100-ms callback phase and can occur less than one second after this timer is set

synthetic_large_elapsed_gap_vector.qualification: Synthetic monotonic-gap arithmetic vector, not an observed firmware outage; one local tick calls the real countdown helper for eight byte slots, one slow byte slot, and twenty halfword slots (29 calls), not a native timer limit.

synthetic_float_boundary_vector.qualification: Synthetic decimal-time boundary vector for inclusive 100-ms callbacks; not a native timestamp

ubind_retry.retry_reset: after 30 one-second halfword updates, high-bit expiry byte +0x17 clears the timer and resets the retry counter; the first update shares the global 100-ms callback phase

outer.msgId: current shared counter; reset only above 65535; no increment

heartbeat.watchdog_activation: UBindok calls 0x9b02ac54 after Utm and getLoginInfo; that hbok call arms the independent 61-second watchdog, and later inbound hbok calls rearm it
heartbeat.period_callback: 0x9b030364 sends the heartbeat then restores the 60-second period
heartbeat.watchdog_expiry: seed rand from native OS uint32 tick using LCG 0x5851f42d4c957f2d+1; ((state>>32)&0x7fffffff)%10 selects a 300-ms step from 0 through 2700 ms before scheduling the separate 1-second heartbeat callback
heartbeat.miss_counter_increment: only when period==1000, after the watchdog-triggered 1-second callback; hbok clears the miss byte
heartbeat.disconnect_effect: clear host_managed and lock, then invoke HBOK: increment shared msgId, clear misses, and stop the watchdog. Preserve host IP/MAC and the independent product+0x4ed gate, so eligible UBind retry may resume

ret.r_200: clear report-context byte +6 retry marker only; leave report timer unchanged

hbok.watchdog_expiry: after watchdog, random 0..2700-ms delay then schedule the separate one-second heartbeat callback; managed=false gate stops the watchdog

source_fields.hex6B: temporary frame; bytes from offset4 become source clock text and invoke the original clock setter/save event; log length byte2+3.
source_fields.hex6C: temporary frame <=55 bytes; nonzero byte4 reads prior product+0x4ac via 0x9b025888; only prior mode 0x3c sets timer+0x06=0x4000+byte4 and queues a raw report. It then stores min(byte4,0x3c) into product+0x4ac via 0x9b025808 and sets timer+0x08=0x405a. Packet byte4 alone is not the timer+0x06 gate; log length byte2+2.
source_fields.hex6D: temporary frame <=55 bytes; logger length is byte2+2. Source zeroes a 55-byte destination, copies byte2-2 bytes from the payload at offset4 into it, calls 0x9b02644c, and clears timer+0x18; declared byte2 0x09 copies seven bytes (GNET-KE from GNET-KEY), while 0x0a copies all eight.
source_fields.hex6E: temporary frame <=55 bytes; requires prefix7e7e and byte3=0x6e; bytes4=1,5=1,6!=0 set timer+0x1c to0x4000+byte6.
